messages:
Carla: heads-up — planning a partial v2 shift for eu-west-1 tonight at 00:30 UTC. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m with auto-pause thresholds. Need final pinlist & a short release-note blurb. objections?
Ben: +1. Please ensure mobile SDKs are on the pinlist — saw a 503 blip last week.
Alice: Agree with Ben. Also hold the header-normalize flag for mobile clients until we verify compatibility.
DeployBot: Automated: rollout scheduled 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z. Steps: 10% (5m check) -> 50% (10m check) -> 100%. Monitors: error_rate_5m, p99_latency. Auto-pause if error_rate_5m > 0.5% OR p99_latency > 800ms.
Dave: Who owns the manual rollback if auto-pause triggers? need an operator handback plan.
Carla: Erin is oncall for the window and will own operator handback; Ben will own the rollback playbook.
Erin: oncall acknowledged. I'll add a lightweight probe route for canary so we get early signal (/v2-health).
Ben: added canary probe -> /v2-health responding 200 with <20ms on staging.
Carla: Release notes: keep it short — call out header behavior change and compatibility note for older mobile SDKs. Alice can you draft the blurb?
Alice: I’ll draft and post to #release-notes in ~30m.
DeployBot: Preflight checks: passed. Required deploy token present. Client-pin summary: mobile-sdk <=1.2.3 pinned on eu-west-1.
Ben: Also abort if pinned-client traffic > 2% of total after step increase.
Carla: agreed. We also won't proceed to 100% until E2E in dedicated env passes. Window end target: 02:30 UTC.
Erin: will escalate to oncall-sre if auto-pause occurs.
Carla: final call in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben: +1
Alice: +1
Erin: oncall ready
DeployBot: Rollout started. Step 1 -> shifting 10% traffic to v2 in eu-west-1.
DeployBot: Telemetry update: step1 OK — error_rate_5m 0.07%, p99 210ms.
DeployBot: Proceeding to Step 2 -> shifting 50% traffic.
DeployBot: Telemetry update: error_rate_5m rising to 0.9% on eu-west-1 mobile routes -> auto-pause triggered.
Erin: pausing complete. Initiating rollback for the affected subset.
Ben: seeing 503s from mobile clients; root cause appears to be header-case mismatch from header-normalize in v2. Reverting header normalization for mobile user-agent shim.
Carla: rollforward blocked until mobile hotfix & client-signal update. Drafting a short incident blurb for internal ops.
Alice: Posted to #release-notes: "Deployment paused: investigating increased 503s from mobile clients in EU. Rollback initiated for mobile subset; investigating header normalization interaction."
DeployBot: Rollback complete. Traffic restored to baseline routing. Final status: paused at 50%. Operators: Erin, Bob.
Carla: thanks all — good catch. Follow-ups: Ben to implement a targeted shim + tests, Alice to update public release note and changelog, Erin to monitor telemetry and coordinate with oncall-sre. We'll regroup in 30m. Closing this thread for now.
Ben: will open a PR for the shim and include an integration test.
Erin: continuing to watch dashboards. will post any alerts here.
Carla: closing loop — appreciate the fast responses.
